name: Nexus WhatsApp Bot
description: ADEZ TECH Nexus - WhatsApp bot built on Baileys

SESSION_ID.description: Your WhatsApp session ID (starts with ADEZ~)

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Your WhatsApp number with country code, digits only (no +)

APP_URL.description: Your app URL for keep-alive: https://YOUR-APP-NAME.herokuapp.com (use the same app name you typed above)

API_KEYS.description: Gemini API keys for the AI commands, comma separated (optional)

HEROKU_API_KEY.description: Optional. Lets the .update command redeploy the bot. Get it with: heroku authorizations:create

GITHUB_REPO.description: Optional. Only if you deployed from your own fork, e.g. yourname/baileys. Used by .update

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Optional. GitHub token so .update can sync your fork
